facts: Building dates from 1757, altered and extended from 1808. The southeast front has seven bays, doors in the second, fifth and sixth bays, shutters and a narrow end opening. The northwest rear has five bays. Southwest gable has a recessed entrance and northeast gable a slit.

record: National Trust for Scotland roof conservation description
facts: Traditional thatch renewed and limewash and chimneys repaired in the current conservation era.
